description: Compare the seven classifiers side by side
content: Waits for and takes the results of every branch. Checks that all were evaluated on the same test images (digest), recomputes the accuracy from the predictions and matches it against the reported value. Shows a ranking by accuracy, training time and prediction time, and in words whether the differences mean anything against the error from the number of test images, and passes it all on.

outputs.name: comparison
outputs.description: Model names, accuracies, times, every model's predictions, the test images and labels
